files.what: City "District Elections" page: final map, links to the residency lookup, lawsuit and settlement. States the lines were adjusted to follow parcel lines per the LA County Registrar GIS specification.
Draft maps page (Maps 101 to 113, Joint Draft Map) and link to the NDC public mapping app.
Official final council district map PDF, ArcGIS Pro export 5 December 2023. Static.
Ordinance 23-4, adopted 13 June 2023, establishing by-district elections from the "City of Santa Clarita District Map" (Exhibit A); Districts 1 and 3 elected 2024, Districts 2, 4 and 5 in 2026.
Layer metadata for "City Council Districts" on the City's own ArcGIS Server (used by the City's "Mapping Your City" residency app, portal item 4b3cfb271314475db6518999b4747876).

City GIS council districts. 5 features, GeoJSON WGS84 (native EPSG:2229). District number in District (integer), name in DistrictName. District 2 is two parts. Matches the RR/CC layer to within 1 percent area per district.
